CheckTitle: Active admins have at least two enrolled authenticators
Description: Active Okta users with any admin role are evaluated for at least two active enrolled MFA factors or authenticators.
Risk: Admins with fewer than two active authenticators face higher takeover risk and greater lockout risk if their only enrolled method is lost or reset.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, review active users with admin roles.
2. Check each admin's enrolled security methods or factors.
3. Require enrollment in at least two authenticators, including a phishing-resistant option where possible.
4. Update authenticator enrollment policies so admins are prompted to enroll missing authenticators.
5. Follow up with admins who remain below the requirement.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure every active administrator is enrolled in at least two active authenticators to reduce takeover and lockout risk.

Notes: Requires okta.users.read and okta.roles.read. User Factors API output is filtered by the highest-priority applicable enrollment policy.
